annual_basis: Every calendar year from the first year UCB printed a Cimzia figure (2007) through 2025, from UCB's annual reports.

launch_evidence.quote: New products Cimzia® (certolizumab pegol) and Vimpat® (lacosamide) were launched in 2008 (in April in the U.S.

search_log: Listed UCB reports via https://www.ucb.com/investors/download-center (pages 0-8): FY04-FY25 annual reports are on ucb.com; downloaded FY08-FY25 with curl and read with pdftotext -layout.

Each year taken from that year's own annual report, current-year column of the net sales by product table (EUR million). Every year cross-checked against the next year's prior-year column; only difference is 2016 (own report 1 307; FY2017 report prints 2016 restated as 1 304, own-year used).
2022 and 2024 quote is the report's net-sales call-out because the by-product table prints the figure on the line below the label.

no_quarterly_series.source_quote: UCB half-year report 2025, table 'For the six months ended June 30, Actual, Variance; EUR million; 2025, 2024, actual rates, CER' | CIMZIA® 959 997 -4% -2%
no_quarterly_series.details: UCB publishes product net sales in half-year reports (six months ended June 30) and annual reports; no quarterly product table was found on the UCB download center. Quarters are not interpolated per contract.
